name: 18072 · Pen Argyl, PA
findings: ZIP 18072 (Pen Argyl) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18072 (Pen Argyl) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
